stations.title: Taking in the need
stations.purpose: Identify the person who will use the forecast and the choice it will help them make.

stations.title: Framing and success criterion
stations.purpose: Specify what will be known when predicting and define a decision rule before seeing results.

stations.title: Data
stations.purpose: Check the timing, coverage and quality of the data the prediction will actually use.

stations.title: Baseline
stations.purpose: Measure the simplest credible forecast under the same Protocol that will govern the Candidate.

stations.title: Build, iterate, evaluate
stations.purpose: Change one part at a time and inspect development evidence before choosing another change.

stations.title: Compare and decide
stations.purpose: Read a paired Comparison in context and keep the person’s reasoning with their Decision.

stations.title: Held-out pass
stations.purpose: Run the protected assessment at the evaluator and return an aggregate report for the final Decision.

stations.title: Deliver, monitor, next cycle
stations.purpose: Hand over the forecast and its limits, then decide what evidence would trigger another Study.
